result.summary: All 12 frozen golden answers agree with the original repository sources; no material ambiguity was found. The 2x2 design, balanced order, exact input-ID preparation, cache accounting and revised setup-cost accounting are suitable for the explicitly bounded local pilot. The initial loss of partial output on stream failure was fixed before scoring and the revised error paths passed offline checks. No remaining blocking implementation defect was found. The first 17 persisted scored rows covered all four cells and passed input/cache/output-token invariants; this review does not certify the unfinished 144-call run or any eventual quality/performance conclusion.

Source inspection confirms duplicate_key, excluded key contract_revision, and completed_incomplete for the three validation questions.

Source inspection confirms the remaining seven answers: stale input: spec; remaining budget 3; integer validator result becomes false; opaque recovery returns outcome_unknown; digest-only freshness does not reject the A/B/A change; UTF-8 repair A; revision-exact receipt coverage C. Temporary-database execution confirmed stale writes, credit transfer/replay, validator-type handling and opaque recovery. Separate Python assertions checked UTF-8 and revision-coverage counterexamples.

Final checks passed: 23 scorer cases, 12 positive workload cases, 144 unique planned rows, every cell in each position nine times, six integrity controls, 144 mocked trial paths, invalid-cache invariant detection, four summary contrasts, revised setup-cost accounting, and retained partial output for SSE-error and missing-final streams. The earlier mock summary fixture lacked snapshot_hash_ms after the parent's concurrent analyzer update; the corrected fixture passed. Final harness hashes are recorded.

Reviewed full runner/client/analyzer. Randomized task blocks and four rotated orders balance positions. Cold cache reuse must be zero; warm reuse must equal the prepared prefix; reused plus evaluated tokens must equal full input. Operational latency includes validation and restore. Revised accounting includes common rendering, representation-specific token preparation, prefix priming, snapshot save and snapshot hashing. Summaries distinguish answer correctness, JSON validity and exact output identity.

At final inspection, 17 persisted scored rows covered all four cells. The saved prefix has 3752 tokens. All inspected rows had correct cache/input accounting, generated-token-array length equal to predicted_n, no invariant errors and one effective generation profile. All 12 prepared inputs recorded native integer token equality. Current harness hashes match the recorded setup. Captured row data retain incorrect answers without normalization.

The snapshot is hashed at creation, but verify_cache compares only sidecar profile and prefix metadata before restore. It does not rehash the referenced file on every restoration. The current same-process controlled experiment therefore provides metadata-compatibility controls, not authenticated rejection of an externally swapped snapshot blob.
